summary: The note describes the League of West German Communists (BWK), a Maoist communist political organization in the Federal Republic of Germany. It was active from 1980 to 1995 and was one of the last surviving K-Groups, which emerged after the German student movement. After German reunification it merged into the Party of Democratic Socialism.
one_line: The League of West German Communists was a Maoist West German party active from 1980 to 1995 that merged into the Party of Democratic Socialism after reunification.
